name: .264 Cal-092gr Power Hammer™

note: Recommended use: Big Game Hunting. The product page also says: "This is a 2mm hollow point bullet that we are calling the Power Hammer™. This Power Hammer™ is a flat based design inherent for superior accuracy and light weight for high velocity potential."
